votes.motion: Council Member Gaston moved to APPROVE Resolution 2023-51- A Resolution Proclaiming January 16th as Religious Freedom Day. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hales

Council Member Hales moved to APPROVE Resolution 2023-52- Consideration and Vote on a Resolution indicating the intent of the Bluffdale City CouncU to adjust a common municipal boundary with Draper City (Application 2023-27). The motion was seconded by Council Member Gaston
Council Member Kallas moved to APPROVE Ordinance 2023-15 an Ordinance updating the Code for Nuisance Legal Action. The motion was seconded by Council Member Aston

Council Member Kalias moved to APPROVE Ordinance 2023-20 - Text Amendments to Code 11.150.080, 11.160.290, and other related text language regarding assurances for completion ofimprovements with applicable adopted City Engineering Standards related to development with the minor text amendments mentioned. The motion was seconded by Council Member Aston

Council Member Kalias moved to APPROVE Ordinance 2023-25- Text Amendments to the Bluffdale City Land Use Ordinances 11.11.100.050(R)(2.b) regarding the size of tower signs allowed in the SD-X Bringhurst Station Zone. The motion was seconded by Council Member Crockett

Council Member Gaston moved to APPROVE Ordinance 2023-23 to amend Sections 11.90 and 11.100 of the Bluffdale City Code related to eliminating the minimum lot area requirements and reducing frontage and setback requirements for the Heavy Commercial and Light Industrial Zone, along with other related provisions. The motion was seconded by Council Member Crockett

Mayor Hall moved to APPROVE RDA Resolution 2023-06 - A Resolution Authorizing an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement with Salt Lake County Housing, allocating dollars to Salt Lake County Housing Trust Fund. The motion was seconded by Board Member Hales
